title: 译林版初中英语 八年级下册（8B，新课标）
description: Yilin Press junior-high English 8B, the edition revised for the 2022 national curriculum standard and used in Jiangsu. Outline only: unit titles, topics, grammar points, language functions and short word lists; no textbook text. Speaking tasks are original to Speakwow. Theme categories (人与自我 / 人与社会 / 人与自然) are our own classification against the standard, not the teacher's book.
subject: english
standard: 义务教育英语课程标准（2022年版）三级
